blocks.text: Product Description               Amazon Basics 65 Piece Home Basic Repair Tool Kit is idea for everyday household projects, repairs, and DIY tasks. This set includes: (1) 13oz Fiberglass Hammer, (16) SAE and metric Hex Key Wrenches, (1) 16ft Tape Measure with auto locking mechanism, (1) 9-inch torpedo level, (1) retractable utility knife, (1) slip joint plier, (1) needle nose plier, (8) SAE sockets 1/32, 3/16, 7/32, ¼, 9/32, 5/16, 11/32, 3/8, (1) 5 inch long ¼-inch ratchet handle, (2) Chrome-Vanadium Phillips and flat head screwdrivers, (30) Screwdriver Bits, (1) Magnetic Bit Holder, carrying bag included.                  From the Manufacturer               Amazon Basics

items: Includes 8 piece SAE and 8 piece metric hex keys (Allen Wrenches)
13-ounce fiberglass hammer; 16-foot tape measure with auto locking mechanism; 9-inch torpedo level; retractable 6-3/4-inch utility knife with 8 snap-off blade sections
Includes both standard slip joint pliers with two locking positions as well as needle nose pliers with 1-inch jaw
Chrome-Vanadium Phillips and flat head screwdrivers; 5 inch long ¼-inch ratchet with 8 SAE sockets (1/32, 3/16, 7/32, ¼, 9/32, 5/16, 11/32, 3/8)
30 piece bit set containing various flat, Philips, square, star and hex bits
